claims: Gemini is 'a step function above any other model' at turning a folder of UI screenshots into a design language
Referencing a design-system file from CLAUDE.md keeps AI-generated UI 'true to the design' across sessions and tools
He also runs parallel agents on multiple features and a Claude skill that keeps app context up to date (not shown)
how_to_steps: Create a local folder of screenshots of apps/websites whose UI you like
Drag the whole folder into Gemini
Ask Gemini to write a 'design language' describing the design elements you like, then a design system
Paste Gemini's output into a CLAUDE.md (or separate design-system file referenced from CLAUDE.md)
Tell Claude Code / Cursor to reference that file whenever it builds UI
